subject: Architecture
title: Self-Powering Skyscrapers
description: A short lesson to help you apply Self-Powering Skyscrapers.

hook.text: Future skyscrapers will harvest energy from wind, sun, and even footsteps — built-in power for every floor.

buildup.text: Building-integrated photovoltaics turn entire glass facades into solar panels — invisible power generation.

discovery.text: Bahrain's World Trade Center has three wind turbines between its twin towers — generating 15% of its power.

twist.text: Piezoelectric floors can harvest energy from pedestrian footsteps — each step generates a small electric charge.

climax.text: Combining solar glass, wind turbines, and heat recovery, future towers may never need external electricity.

punchline.text: The building is the power plant. Every window is a solar panel.

quiz.question: How does Bahrain's World Trade Center generate power?
options: Solar panels cover the entire roof surface
Three wind turbines sit between the twin towers
Geothermal wells beneath the foundation heat water
